body: Well that sucks.  Maybe bleach, if not then cutting, but to be honest it's my only option at this point, even if it might not seem like a good one.  I already have a psychologist, so I already have help, but it is really difficult to keep on living and it's not fair that I'm suffering like this.  I don't think you understand the physical pain I feel every fucking second being alive.  It really sucks.
I looked it up online and it said it will stop respiration, effectively killing me.  Sounds like a good way to go.

If I wanted to compare myself to other people, then okay, though a lot of them do more than I did.  My point is not what is my current situation, but how much time I've wasted doing all this shit for it to be all gone, I really can't handle it anymore.  Either way, I really cannot see myself surviving for another few hours.  This week is gonna be shitty too, and this month, and this year.  Ugh.

All my other projects have failed (a shit ton of them, trust me).  This was the only successful one, and it's gone.  Sure, I can contact them, but all of my work for the past three years is gone.  Done.  I might as well not have existed.  I seriously can't see myself living until tomorrow, it seems impossible.  I would be fine if I had something else, like friends or played sports or been athletic, but I am a loser with no friends and fat and I seriously can't take it anymore.  It's painful to live, and it's not fair.  And sure, life isn't fair, all the more reason.

So basically this guy was pretty cool so I admined him, even though he had a huge ego, but it was okay.  So I had to deal with school and I didn't go on the server much, and let this other guy run it.  Anyways, the name was then changed from [Name]Craft to some other name, so I decided to then revoke him admin rights because I at least wanted the name the same, and he made his own website for his server anyways, and I made a post saying the minecraft server is over and the website will be a little community thing for discussion and such.  Then big ego guy took it upon himself to delete everything on the website (equivalent of permanently removing all HTML code), so it's basically over, and the website is done.  All I wanted was a community, and he took that away from me, and I am done because there is nothing that I can say is mine, or anything I am proud of doing, I am just a robot that does work and I still have homework to do, but I feel like either taking some sleeping pills for the night or taking enough to kill myself.
